scope: independent source review, real loopback HTTP clients with simulated provider only; no production credentials/services or real provider calls

findings.issue: Removing a routed OAuth model invalidated config after remote mutation.
findings.resolution: Preserve reviewed aliases/declarations, disable affected connection, and preserve unrelated provider scopes.

findings.issue: Remote deletion/status followed by local commit failure or uncertain acknowledgement left divergent state.
findings.resolution: In-memory original file/status plus bounded compensation under reloadMu; explicit confirmed/incomplete rollback result.

findings.issue: Independent review reproduced HTTP 200 on enable/cancelled when directory failure swallowed cancellation.
findings.resolution: Check ctx.Err after mutation and before reconciliation callback returns; deterministic cancelled_after_apply test and repeated cancellation regression.

limits: This review does not establish external provider credential recovery; fixtures prove local transaction behavior.
If compensation itself fails, oauth_credential_rollback_incomplete preserves uncertainty and gives connectivity/write-access recovery conditions.
Automatically disabled connections require reviewed repair and explicit re-enable.
